free_tier.stated: Kaggle supplies compute and model access to whoever hosts a benchmark with it, quoted: 'High compute quota & model access: We provide a very high complimentary compute quota and access to leading models for your evaluations, including OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Grok, Qwen, and DeepSeek.' The open door for conference organisers, quoted: 'As a NeurIPS researcher, we provide additional complimentary compute and support by filling out. Just mention "NeurIPS 2026" in the form for expedited approvals.' The platform is self-serve, quoted: 'Getting started is quick and entirely self-serve. You can get started right away at www.kaggle.com/benchmarks'.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: This is the one route where a solo person can obtain model access to six frontier providers on one quota: the benchmark runs against OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Grok, Qwen and DeepSeek models from a single Kaggle account, which is otherwise six separate signups with six separate cards. It composes with the free notebook quota in compute/kaggle-notebooks, because the SDK runs inside Kaggle Notebooks.

limits.value: the compute is attached to a published benchmark rather than to a person: the quota pays for evaluations that run on Kaggle, so it cannot be spent on a training run, and the larger NeurIPS allocation needs an accepted conference submission.

notes: The amount is unverified by design: 'a very high complimentary compute quota' carries no number on any page read, so the record claims the mechanism and not the size. Three explanations for why the quota exists were considered: it subsidises benchmark supply for Kaggle's leaderboards, it is developer marketing for the model providers, and it replaces engineering work the labs would otherwise do. The page states the first two in its own words ('Managed infrastructure', 'Grow exposure to the Kaggle community'). The gate that matters is that the compute is scoped to evaluations, so a reader should not plan a fine-tune on it.
